description: Fully reimagined single-story estate on over half an acre south of the Boulevard in prime Woodland Hills. The chef's kitchen features porcelain slab countertops and premium Thermador appliances, opening to a light-filled great room anchored by a wood-burning fireplace. The main residence offers 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms across approximately 3,600 sq. ft. of warm modern living space. The entertainer's backyard delivers an in-ground pool, outdoor kitchen, and multiple lounge areas under mature trees. A detached, approximately 600 sq. ft. ADU with 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom and a full kitchen is ideal for guests, multi-generational living, or rental income. Moments from Taft Charter High and The Village.
